facts.craftsman: A craftsman sits on a long bench, carving a pentacle with a hammer and chisel.
facts.post-pentacles: On the wooden post at the right, finished pentacles hang one after another.
facts.more-pentacles: Pentacles also lie one each on the ground below the post and at his feet (eight in all).
facts.focused: His head is bowed, and he is absorbed in the work alone.
facts.distant-town: A town and a tower can be seen far off on the left.
facts.clothes: He wears blue clothes with a black apron and red trousers.

glosses.post-pentacles: Results built up one by one.
glosses.distant-town: A time of building skill a little apart from the world.

reversedGloss.waning: Tired of repetition, the focus and care drop.
reversedGloss.excess: Perfectionism keeps fixing the same thing.

misdescriptions.wrong: He works in a workshop in the middle of the city.
